findings.message: saveExport surface was truthfully recorded as not_available because the current game shell does not expose a save-export surface; this is not treated as a failure.

Evidence records a passing build/public-asset leakage scan with no personaTemplateId, behaviorInstructions, answerKey, rubric, targetDiagnosis, or patientFacts tokens in static/server output or public assets. The public contract projector is also documented as removing hidden fields.
Console, IndexedDB, localStorage, sessionStorage, and CacheStorage were observed and scanned with zero sensitive matches and zero failed surfaces.
Public and private journey artifacts are separately identified by path, visibility, size, and SHA-256 digest; no evidence indicates private journey data was placed in the public artifact.
